resources.string: These apply the next time you press Play.
These apply at once, in the game too.
Game settings wait for the Launcher to start, a few seconds after the app opens.
The Launcher could not save its settings (%1$s). The next Play uses the last saved ones.
D2GL on the GPU, full screen. Recommended.
The game\'s own renderer through Wine. For when Glide does not start.
Fewer lines are smoother; the game is scaled up to fill the screen. Its graphics options are in the game: Options, Video Options, D2GL.
480 lines on older or entry-level Adreno GPUs, a medium size on Mali GPUs, full size on newer Adrenos.
The screen the official PD2 launcher opens on. Its window needs room: the full size shows all of it.
D2GL\'s settings for the game\'s look, written at the next Play. What you change in the game (Options, Video Options, D2GL) stays until you pick another profile.
Performance on older or entry-level Adreno GPUs and on Mali GPUs, Default on newer Adrenos.
D2GL\'s advanced settings tuned down for older devices: a simpler shader, no sharpening, no bloom.
This screen shows up to %1$d frames a second. At 60 the game uses less battery and stays cooler, but moves less smoothly.
The game opens on the online screen.
The game keeps its sound when another app is in front.
Keep the screen on during play
The screen does not dim or turn off while the game shows.
A small counter in a corner of the game: the frames the game draws each second.
On. Android may pause downloads and installs while the screen is off. Choose \"Not optimised\" for PD2 Launcher in the list that opens.
Off for PD2 Launcher. Work goes on in the background.
Off. Android may stop the game while PD2 Launcher is in the background.
On. The session notification keeps the Launcher and the game running.
Optimised. Android may pause downloads and installs while the screen is off.
Project Diablo 2 needs Diablo II and Lord of Destruction. Choose where they come from.
Diablo II and Lord of Destruction from Blizzard (about 2 GB), and Project Diablo 2 from Project Diablo 2. Your CD keys come in Install.
Copy your Diablo II folder from your PC to this device, then choose it here. It will be copied into the app.
Waiting for the Launcher to start.
Continue opens Android\'s folder picker: choose the Diablo II folder you copied from your PC.
